verdict.rationale: x402 enables agent wallets to autonomously discover and pay for services mid-task (agentic accounts, Bazaar discovery, MCP tool-call discovery, batch settlement for high-frequency loops), which supports background autonomous payment automations, but the product itself is a payment protocol/infrastructure layer, not a scheduler or automation orchestrator — there's no evidence of triggers, cron-like scheduling, or persistent background task management outside of payment transactions. missing for 10: evidence of actual task/workflow scheduling or orchestration beyond payment execution, independent hands-on validation of autonomous background operation over time, and details on error handling/retry logic for unattended long-running agent loops.
